name: Sound
description: Class for playing in-game 2D and 3D sounds.

parameters.name: is_2d_sound
parameters.description: Whether to spawn it as 2D or 3D

parameters.name: auto_destroy
parameters.description: Whether to destroy after finished playing

parameters.name: sound_type
parameters.description: Used to apply user's volume settings

parameters.name: keep_playing_when_silent
parameters.description: Only used if 3D sound - Use with caution, it may cause performance issues!

parameters.name: loop_mode
parameters.description: Whether should force sound to loop

parameters.name: auto_play
parameters.description: Whether it should immediately play when loaded

functions.name: FadeIn
functions.description: Plays the sound with a fade effect

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Seconds into the sound to start playing from

functions.name: FadeOut
functions.description: Stops the sound with a fade effect

parameters.name: destroy_after_fadeout
parameters.description: Whether to destroy the Sound after fading out

functions.name: Play
functions.description: Starts the sound

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Seconds into the sound to start playing from

functions.name: SetFalloffDistance
functions.description: If a 3D Sound, sets the distance which the sound is inaudible

parameters.name: falloff_distance
parameters.description: Distance from the inner radius at which the sound becomes inaudible

functions.name: SetInnerRadius
functions.description: If a 3D Sound, sets the radius within which the volume is 100%

parameters.name: inner_radius
parameters.description: Radius within which the volume is 100%

functions.name: SetLowPassFilter
functions.description: Sets low-pass filter frequency. Sets 0 to disable it.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: The new low-pass filter frequency. Sets 0 to disable it

functions.name: SetPaused
functions.description: Pauses or resumes the sound

functions.name: SetPitch
functions.description: Sets the Sound's pitch

functions.name: SetVolume
functions.description: Sets the Sound's volume

parameters.name: new_volume
parameters.description: Volume multiplier, 1 is the original volume

functions.name: Stop
functions.description: Stops the sound

functions.name: StopDelayed
functions.description: Stops the sound after the provided delay

functions.name: Is2D
functions.description: Gets if the sound is 2D

functions.name: IsPlaying
functions.description: Gets if the sound is playing

functions.name: GetDuration
functions.description: Gets the duration of the Sound

functions.name: GetPitch
functions.description: Gets the pitch multiplier

functions.name: GetVolume
functions.description: Gets the volume multiplier

functions.name: GetLowPassFilter
functions.description: Gets the low pass filter frequency

functions.name: GetInnerRadius
functions.description: Gets the radius within which the volume is 100%

functions.name: GetFalloffDistance
functions.description: Gets the distance at which the sound becomes inaudible

functions.name: GetSoundType
functions.description: Gets the Sound Type, used to apply the user's volume settings

functions.name: GetPath
functions.description: Gets the asset path of this Sound
